name: devsangam
description: 1. Product direction I recommend building one responsive React PWA first, not separate React web + React Native applications.
author: Shivamm Chaudhary

scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,API -c auto "npm run dev -w @devsangam/web" "npm run dev -w @devsangam/api"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @devsangam/web && npm run lint -w @devsangam/api
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w @devsangam/web && npm run lint:fix -w @devsangam/api
